scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build:engine: cmake -S engine/cpp -B engine/cpp/build -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build engine/cpp/build
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
